summary: Easy top five, then a wall: the UK, France, Japan and Saudi Arabia all sit outside the top 10 and cost lives. Too harsh for a daily, but a good Blitz.
reasons: Casual got the top five (US, China, India, Germany, Russia), then ran out of lives in 10 guesses on UK #11, Saudi Arabia #29, France #13, Japan #19 and UAE #45. Crowd estimate 4.5, under the 5 to 6 target.
Fan went 10/10 in 11 guesses, losing 1 on the UK. Italy, Canada, Brazil, Hong Kong and Taiwan are fair reveals, but a typical player reaches for rich-sounding countries first.
Blitz has no lives and 76 countries carry a count: 21 of 22 casual names scored.
fixes: Prompt says countries, but #8 Hong Kong is a territory (the source column is Country/Territory): say 'countries or territories' so it is fair game.

Drop India aliases that are not names of the country: 'Indian society', 'Indian social structure', 'Traditional Indian social structure', 'Indian traditional social structure', 'India etymology', 'Bharath Niwas'; and Italy's 'Roman New Republic'. Harmless in play, but junk.
